meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构搜索并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要跨文件修改同一类代码结构。
copy.tagline_en: Search code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to modify the same kind of code structure across files.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会用 ast-grep 工具按代码结构（而非纯文本）搜索和改写代码，支持 25 种语言。它能按语法形状查找函数、调用、类、导入等，做批量替换（如把 console.log 改成 logger.info），并在改写前先预览改动。
howto.when: 当你想按代码结构查找或批量改写代码（比如找出所有带 Request 参数的函数、把 console.log 改写为 logger.info）时触发；纯文本搜索则用 grep/rg。

say.text: 把仓库里所有 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x)
找出所有空 catch 块
把这个项目里的 require() 换成 import

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses ast-grep to search and rewrite code by code structure (not plain text), supporting 25 languages. It can find functions, calls, classes, imports by syntax shape, perform batch rewrites (e.g., console.log to logger.info), and preview changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to find or batch-rewrite code by structure (e.g., find all functions taking a Request parameter, rewrite console.log to logger.info); use grep/rg for plain-text searches.

say_en.text: Change all console.log(x) to logger.info(x) in the repo
Replace require() with import across this project
